mapper.sql: FROM doctor_leave l LEFT JOIN doctor d ON d.id = l.doctor_id LEFT JOIN department dep ON dep.id = d.department_id
l.*, d.name AS doctor_name, dep.name AS department_name
mapper.select: SELECT WHERE l.id = #{id} AND l.deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE OF l
SELECT ORDER BY l.created_at DESC, l.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM doctor_leave WHERE doctor_id = #{doctorId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 'APPROVED' AND start_time < #{end} AND end_time > #{start} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id FROM doctor_schedule WHERE doctor_id = #{doctorId} AND deleted = 0 AND status IN ('DRAFT', 'PUBLISHED', 'CLOSED') AND start_time < #{end} AND end_time > #{start} ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appointment WHERE deleted = 0 AND status IN ('PENDING', 'CONFIRMED') AND schedule_id IN #{scheduleId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO doctor_leave_schedule (leave_id, schedule_id) VALUES (#{leaveId}, #{scheduleId})
mapper.update: UPDATE doctor_leave SET status = 'WITHDRAWN', updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND doctor_id = #{doctorId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 'PENDING'
